title: 原位岩體應力量測~In-situ rock-stress measurement
focus: 區分原位應力、測試擾動與反演假設，建立可審查的應力模型~Separate in-situ stress, test disturbance and inversion assumptions in an auditable stress model
summary: 本課聚焦區分原位應力、測試擾動與反演假設，建立可審查的應力模型。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。~This course focuses on separate in-situ stress, test disturbance and inversion assumptions in an auditable stress model. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.

units.anchor: 覆土重量基準~Overburden stress baseline
units.title: 覆土重量基準~Overburden stress baseline
units.mechanism: 垂直自重應力由上覆岩層重量積分而來，但山谷地形與構造應力會使局部狀態偏離一維近似。覆土估值提供量級檢查，不能取代現地量測，更不能據此假設水平應力必然相同。 假設平均密度2600 kg/m³、深度500 m，σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa；未計地形與構造修正。 把隧道深度誤用為海拔會造成大幅應力錯估，忽略谷側自由面也可能高估約束；之後用錯誤基準判定量測失敗，反而刪除真實高水平應力。~Vertical overburden follows the integrated weight of rock, but topography and tectonic stress alter local conditions. The estimate is a scale check rather than a replacement for measurement, and does not imply equal horizontal stress. With assumed mean density 2600 kg/m³ and depth 500 m, σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa, excluding topographic and tectonic corrections. Using altitude instead of cover depth grossly misestimates stress, while ignoring a valley free surface overstates confinement. The incorrect baseline may then cause genuine high horizontal stress to be rejected.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平均密度2600 kg/m³、深度500 m，σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa；未計地形與構造修正。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed mean density 2600 kg/m³ and depth 500 m, σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa, excluding topographic and tectonic corrections.
units.verify: 用地形、分層密度及孔口高程建立自重包絡，與量測分量在同一坐標比較；顯著差異須先查基準與局部地形，再由岩工工程師評估是否反映構造或測試擾動。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把隧道深度誤用為海拔會造成大幅應力錯估，忽略谷側自由面也可能高估約束；之後用錯誤基準判定量測失敗，反而刪除真實高水平應力。~Build an overburden envelope from topography, layered density and collar elevation and compare measured components in one frame; investigate datum and topography before interpreting differences as tectonics or testing disturbance. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using altitude instead of cover depth grossly misestimates stress, while ignoring a valley free surface overstates confinement. The incorrect baseline may then cause genuine high horizontal stress to be rejected.
units.failure: 把隧道深度誤用為海拔會造成大幅應力錯估，忽略谷側自由面也可能高估約束；之後用錯誤基準判定量測失敗，反而刪除真實高水平應力。~Using altitude instead of cover depth grossly misestimates stress, while ignoring a valley free surface overstates confinement. The incorrect baseline may then cause genuine high horizontal stress to be rejected.
units.misconception: 隧道海拔乘岩石重度就是上覆岩體垂直應力。~Tunnel altitude multiplied by rock unit weight gives vertical overburden stress.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄覆土重量基準的資料來源與適用條件。用地形、分層密度及孔口高程建立自重包絡，與量測分量在同一坐標比較；顯著差異須先查基準與局部地形，再由岩工工程師評估是否反映構造或測試擾動。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for overburden stress baseline. Build an overburden envelope from topography, layered density and collar elevation and compare measured components in one frame; investigate datum and topography before interpreting differences as tectonics or testing disturbance.

units.anchor: 應力張量與主值~Stress tensor and principal values
units.title: 應力張量與主值~Stress tensor and principal values
units.mechanism: 應力是具有方向的張量，單一法向讀值不能描述岩體三維受力。主應力由張量特徵值求得，旋轉坐標只改變分量表達，不改變主值；壓縮正負號與剪應力定義需一致。 假設平面σx=12、σy=8、τxy=3 MPa，主值10±√13，得13.61及6.39 MPa；未代表第三主值。 交換剪應力符號會旋轉主方向，單位或坐標軸混淆又可能保持合理主值卻方向錯誤；支護與岩爆評估因此可能針對錯誤方位。~Stress is a directional tensor, not one normal reading. Principal stresses are its eigenvalues; rotating coordinates changes components but not the principal values. Compression sign convention and shear definitions must remain consistent throughout the analysis. For assumed plane components σx=12, σy=8 and τxy=3 MPa, principal values are 10±√13=13.61 and 6.39 MPa; no third principal stress is specified. Reversing shear sign rotates principal direction; unit or axis mistakes can leave plausible magnitudes with incorrect orientation. Support and rockburst assessments may consequently focus on the wrong direction.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平面σx=12、σy=8、τxy=3 MPa，主值10±√13，得13.61及6.39 MPa；未代表第三主值。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed plane components σx=12, σy=8 and τxy=3 MPa, principal values are 10±√13=13.61 and 6.39 MPa; no third principal stress is specified.
units.verify: 獨立計算特徵值並檢查跡與行列式在旋轉前後不變，對照儀器座標到地理座標的旋轉矩陣；報告列出量測分量、符號和未辨識方向，避免用二維結果假裝完整三維狀態。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：交換剪應力符號會旋轉主方向，單位或坐標軸混淆又可能保持合理主值卻方向錯誤；支護與岩爆評估因此可能針對錯誤方位。~Independently calculate eigenvalues and verify invariant trace and determinant, checking the instrument-to-geographic rotation matrix; report measured components, signs and unresolved directions rather than presenting a plane result as complete three-dimensional stress. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Reversing shear sign rotates principal direction; unit or axis mistakes can leave plausible magnitudes with incorrect orientation. Support and rockburst assessments may consequently focus on the wrong direction.
units.failure: 交換剪應力符號會旋轉主方向，單位或坐標軸混淆又可能保持合理主值卻方向錯誤；支護與岩爆評估因此可能針對錯誤方位。~Reversing shear sign rotates principal direction; unit or axis mistakes can leave plausible magnitudes with incorrect orientation. Support and rockburst assessments may consequently focus on the wrong direction.
units.misconception: 只要主應力量值正確，坐標軸和剪應力符號就不重要。~Correct principal magnitudes make coordinate axes and shear signs unimportant.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄應力張量與主值的資料來源與適用條件。獨立計算特徵值並檢查跡與行列式在旋轉前後不變，對照儀器座標到地理座標的旋轉矩陣；報告列出量測分量、符號和未辨識方向，避免用二維結果假裝完整三維狀態。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for stress tensor and principal values. Independently calculate eigenvalues and verify invariant trace and determinant, checking the instrument-to-geographic rotation matrix; report measured components, signs and unresolved directions rather than presenting a plane result as complete three-dimensional stress.

units.anchor: 有效應力與孔壓~Effective stress and pore pressure
units.title: 有效應力與孔壓~Effective stress and pore pressure
units.mechanism: 岩骨架承擔的有效應力取決於總應力與孔壓耦合，Biot係數不一定恰為一。減壓或開挖同時改變邊界與排水條件，不能用同一孔壓直接扣所有已受擾動測點。 假設σ=15 MPa、u=3 MPa、α=0.8，σ′=σ−αu=12.6 MPa；若係數α=1則為12 MPa。 重複扣除已換算過的孔壓會低估有效應力，忽略未平衡壓力又會使不同方法看似矛盾；錯誤可能被誤解為真實的空間應力變化。~Effective skeleton stress depends on total stress, pore pressure and a Biot coefficient that need not equal one. Depressurization and excavation change boundaries and drainage, so one pressure value cannot be subtracted indiscriminately at disturbed locations. For assumed σ=15 MPa, u=3 MPa and α=0.8, σ′=σ−αu=12.6 MPa; with α=1 it becomes 12 MPa. Subtracting pore pressure twice underestimates effective stress, while nonequilibrated pressure makes methods appear inconsistent. Such bookkeeping errors can be mistaken for genuine spatial stress variation.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設σ=15 MPa、u=3 MPa、α=0.8，σ′=σ−αu=12.6 MPa；若係數α=1則為12 MPa。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed σ=15 MPa, u=3 MPa and α=0.8, σ′=σ−αu=12.6 MPa; with α=1 it becomes 12 MPa.
units.verify: 將孔壓量測與應力試驗時間、隔離區間及排水狀態對齊，明列係數來源；比較總應力與有效應力兩種輸出，只有同一物理定義與飽和狀態的結果才可合併。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：重複扣除已換算過的孔壓會低估有效應力，忽略未平衡壓力又會使不同方法看似矛盾；錯誤可能被誤解為真實的空間應力變化。~Align pore-pressure observations with test time, isolated interval and drainage state and document coefficient origin; report total and effective values separately, combining only results with consistent physical definition and saturation. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Subtracting pore pressure twice underestimates effective stress, while nonequilibrated pressure makes methods appear inconsistent. Such bookkeeping errors can be mistaken for genuine spatial stress variation.
units.failure: 重複扣除已換算過的孔壓會低估有效應力，忽略未平衡壓力又會使不同方法看似矛盾；錯誤可能被誤解為真實的空間應力變化。~Subtracting pore pressure twice underestimates effective stress, while nonequilibrated pressure makes methods appear inconsistent. Such bookkeeping errors can be mistaken for genuine spatial stress variation.
units.misconception: 所有岩石都必須用等於一的係數扣除孔隙水壓。~Every rock must use a coefficient of exactly one when subtracting pore pressure.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄有效應力與孔壓的資料來源與適用條件。將孔壓量測與應力試驗時間、隔離區間及排水狀態對齊，明列係數來源；比較總應力與有效應力兩種輸出，只有同一物理定義與飽和狀態的結果才可合併。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for effective stress and pore pressure. Align pore-pressure observations with test time, isolated interval and drainage state and document coefficient origin; report total and effective values separately, combining only results with consistent physical definition and saturation.

units.anchor: 套鑽應變回復~Overcoring strain relief
units.title: 套鑽應變回復~Overcoring strain relief
units.mechanism: 套鑽釋放局部約束後的應變，需配合彈性常數反演原始應力。岩石若有裂隙、塑性或溫度變化，回復量不再只來自彈性卸載，感測器黏結和方向也會控制可辨識性。 假設單軸示意E=40 GPa、回復應變200 με，σ=Eε=8 MPa；實際多軸套鑽需完整校正矩陣。 套鑽過程新裂縫會產生突然應變跳動，若照線彈性式解讀便可能得到虛假的高應力；量規脫黏也可能呈現平順但偏低的回復。~Overcoring measures strain released by local unloading and requires elastic constants for stress inversion. Fractures, plasticity and temperature add nonelastic changes, while gauge bonding and orientation control what components can be identified. For an assumed uniaxial illustration E=40 GPa and relieved strain 200 με, σ=Eε=8 MPa; real multiaxial overcoring requires a full calibration matrix. A new crack during overcoring produces a strain jump that linear inversion can misread as high stress; debonded gauges may instead show smooth but falsely low relief.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設單軸示意E=40 GPa、回復應變200 με，σ=Eε=8 MPa；實際多軸套鑽需完整校正矩陣。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed uniaxial illustration E=40 GPa and relieved strain 200 με, σ=Eε=8 MPa; real multiaxial overcoring requires a full calibration matrix.
units.verify: 檢查各量規卸載歷程及溫度補償，試後保存岩心確認破裂與黏結狀態；以同方向試件測彈性常數，反演殘差及異常通道需逐項說明，不以平均值掩蓋失效量規。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：套鑽過程新裂縫會產生突然應變跳動，若照線彈性式解讀便可能得到虛假的高應力；量規脫黏也可能呈現平順但偏低的回復。~Inspect each gauge relief history and temperature correction, preserving recovered core for fracture and bond checks; measure directional elastic properties and explain inversion residuals and faulty channels individually rather than averaging them away. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A new crack during overcoring produces a strain jump that linear inversion can misread as high stress; debonded gauges may instead show smooth but falsely low relief.
units.failure: 套鑽過程新裂縫會產生突然應變跳動，若照線彈性式解讀便可能得到虛假的高應力；量規脫黏也可能呈現平順但偏低的回復。~A new crack during overcoring produces a strain jump that linear inversion can misread as high stress; debonded gauges may instead show smooth but falsely low relief.
units.misconception: 套鑽量到的所有應變都只能來自原始應力釋放。~All strain measured during overcoring must arise solely from original stress relief.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄套鑽應變回復的資料來源與適用條件。檢查各量規卸載歷程及溫度補償，試後保存岩心確認破裂與黏結狀態；以同方向試件測彈性常數，反演殘差及異常通道需逐項說明，不以平均值掩蓋失效量規。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for overcoring strain relief. Inspect each gauge relief history and temperature correction, preserving recovered core for fracture and bond checks; measure directional elastic properties and explain inversion residuals and faulty channels individually rather than averaging them away.

units.anchor: 水力破裂壓力判讀~Hydraulic-fracture pressure interpretation
units.title: 水力破裂壓力判讀~Hydraulic-fracture pressure interpretation
units.mechanism: 壓力歷程包含管路儲能、裂縫起裂、延伸與閉合，不同轉折對應不同物理事件。閉合壓力可提供特定法向應力線索，但既有節理重開與滲漏會讓簡化理論不適用。 假設地表讀值8 MPa、測段低100 m且水密度1000 kg/m³，靜水修正0.981 MPa，井下8.981 MPa；未計流動損失。 把泵停止時的瞬間尖峰當閉合壓力會混入管路效應，隔離失效又可能使壓力下降看似裂縫延伸；兩者均可導致應力量值失真。~Pressure history combines line storage, initiation, propagation and closure, with different transitions representing different processes. Closure informs a specific normal stress, but reopening existing joints and leakage can invalidate simple interpretations. Assume surface pressure 8 MPa and an interval 100 m lower with water density 1000 kg/m³; static correction 0.981 MPa gives 8.981 MPa downhole, excluding flowing losses. Treating the immediate pump-stop spike as closure pressure includes line effects, while failed isolation may make leakage resemble fracture extension. Both distort the inferred stress magnitude.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設地表讀值8 MPa、測段低100 m且水密度1000 kg/m³，靜水修正0.981 MPa，井下8.981 MPa；未計流動損失。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume surface pressure 8 MPa and an interval 100 m lower with water density 1000 kg/m³; static correction 0.981 MPa gives 8.981 MPa downhole, excluding flowing losses.
units.verify: 由合格試驗團隊記錄完整壓力流量時間曲線與隔離狀態，交叉使用不同閉合判讀方法並保存分歧；井下壓力須校正高程與管路效應，判讀由岩工工程師核准，教學值不是加壓指令。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把泵停止時的瞬間尖峰當閉合壓力會混入管路效應，隔離失效又可能使壓力下降看似裂縫延伸；兩者均可導致應力量值失真。~A qualified team records complete pressure-flow-time history and isolation state; compare closure interpretations and retain disagreement, correcting elevation and line effects before rock-engineering approval. Teaching values are not pressurization instructions. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Treating the immediate pump-stop spike as closure pressure includes line effects, while failed isolation may make leakage resemble fracture extension. Both distort the inferred stress magnitude.
units.failure: 把泵停止時的瞬間尖峰當閉合壓力會混入管路效應，隔離失效又可能使壓力下降看似裂縫延伸；兩者均可導致應力量值失真。~Treating the immediate pump-stop spike as closure pressure includes line effects, while failed isolation may make leakage resemble fracture extension. Both distort the inferred stress magnitude.
units.misconception: 泵浦停止後的第一個壓力尖峰就是裂縫閉合壓力。~The first pressure spike after pump shutdown is the fracture closure pressure.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄水力破裂壓力判讀的資料來源與適用條件。由合格試驗團隊記錄完整壓力流量時間曲線與隔離狀態，交叉使用不同閉合判讀方法並保存分歧；井下壓力須校正高程與管路效應，判讀由岩工工程師核准，教學值不是加壓指令。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for hydraulic-fracture pressure interpretation. A qualified team records complete pressure-flow-time history and isolation state; compare closure interpretations and retain disagreement, correcting elevation and line effects before rock-engineering approval. Teaching values are not pressurization instructions.

units.anchor: 孔壁崩落與方位~Borehole breakouts and orientation
units.title: 孔壁崩落與方位~Borehole breakouts and orientation
units.mechanism: 孔壁應力集中可造成成對崩落，但鑽具磨損、節理剝落也可能留下近似形狀。方向推論需符合孔軸、岩性與應力集中模型，裂縫影像和孔徑資料應相互支持而不是互相替代。 假設線彈性均質等向岩、無內壓自由圓孔壁，孔軸沿第三主應力方向；遠場主水平應力20與10 MPa，最大環向壓應力3×20−10=50 MPa。 把單側節理剝落當成應力崩落會給錯誤主方向，孔徑平均又會抹去成對特徵；若未檢查局部破裂，方向結果可能只是鑽進痕跡。~Stress concentration can form paired breakouts, but drilling wear and joint spalling produce similar shapes. Orientation inference must fit the hole axis, lithology and concentration model, with images and calipers providing complementary evidence. Assume homogeneous isotropic linear elasticity, a traction-free circular wall without internal pressure, and borehole axis along the third principal direction; horizontal principal stresses 20 and 10 MPa give maximum hoop compression 50 MPa. Interpreting one-sided joint spalling as a breakout gives a false principal direction, while averaged caliper data erase paired features. Unchecked orientation results may describe drilling marks rather than stress.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設線彈性均質等向岩、無內壓自由圓孔壁，孔軸沿第三主應力方向；遠場主水平應力20與10 MPa，最大環向壓應力3×20−10=50 MPa。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume homogeneous isotropic linear elasticity, a traction-free circular wall without internal pressure, and borehole axis along the third principal direction; horizontal principal stresses 20 and 10 MPa give maximum hoop compression 50 MPa.
units.verify: 比對成對特徵是否沿深度穩定、與已知鑽具方向無關，並查核孔壁裂縫與岩性轉換；方向估計附可用區間及不確定度，僅在模型假設成立時才供主應力方位推論。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把單側節理剝落當成應力崩落會給錯誤主方向，孔徑平均又會抹去成對特徵；若未檢查局部破裂，方向結果可能只是鑽進痕跡。~Check whether paired features persist with depth independently of drilling orientation and compare wall cracks and lithology; report usable intervals and angular uncertainty, inferring stress direction only when the mechanical assumptions are justified. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Interpreting one-sided joint spalling as a breakout gives a false principal direction, while averaged caliper data erase paired features. Unchecked orientation results may describe drilling marks rather than stress.
units.failure: 把單側節理剝落當成應力崩落會給錯誤主方向，孔徑平均又會抹去成對特徵；若未檢查局部破裂，方向結果可能只是鑽進痕跡。~Interpreting one-sided joint spalling as a breakout gives a false principal direction, while averaged caliper data erase paired features. Unchecked orientation results may describe drilling marks rather than stress.
units.misconception: 任何單側孔壁剝落都能直接判定最大主應力方向。~Any one-sided borehole spalling directly establishes the maximum principal-stress direction.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄孔壁崩落與方位的資料來源與適用條件。比對成對特徵是否沿深度穩定、與已知鑽具方向無關，並查核孔壁裂縫與岩性轉換；方向估計附可用區間及不確定度，僅在模型假設成立時才供主應力方位推論。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for borehole breakouts and orientation. Check whether paired features persist with depth independently of drilling orientation and compare wall cracks and lithology; report usable intervals and angular uncertainty, inferring stress direction only when the mechanical assumptions are justified.

units.title: 彈性各向異性~Elastic anisotropy
units.mechanism: 層理岩沿不同方向有不同剛度，量到相同應變未必代表相同應力。以等向性反演各向異性岩石會把材料方向性錯配成應力方向性，因此取樣方向與彈性矩陣須同步交接。 假設同一100 με在兩向模數20與40 GPa下，單軸示意應力分別2與4 MPa；並非完整各向異性解。 模數選錯方向會使應力比例偏差，增加量規數卻不增加方向資訊仍不能解決；過度參數化反演可能完美擬合雜訊而失去物理可信度。~Layered rock has direction-dependent stiffness, so equal strain need not mean equal stress. Isotropic inversion can misattribute material anisotropy to stress anisotropy, requiring specimen orientation and elastic matrices to accompany the measurements. For assumed strain 100 με and directional moduli 20 and 40 GPa, uniaxial illustrative stresses are 2 and 4 MPa, not a full anisotropic solution. Using stiffness from the wrong direction biases stress ratios, and adding gauges without directional diversity does not cure it. An overparameterized inversion can fit noise perfectly while losing physical credibility.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設同一100 με在兩向模數20與40 GPa下，單軸示意應力分別2與4 MPa；並非完整各向異性解。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed strain 100 με and directional moduli 20 and 40 GPa, uniaxial illustrative stresses are 2 and 4 MPa, not a full anisotropic solution.
units.verify: 以定向試件量測多方向剛度及泊松效應，核對儀器方向與層理方向；比較等向與各向異性反演殘差，若資料不足以辨識全部常數，需給出模型範圍而非硬湊唯一解。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：模數選錯方向會使應力比例偏差，增加量規數卻不增加方向資訊仍不能解決；過度參數化反演可能完美擬合雜訊而失去物理可信度。~Test oriented specimens for directional stiffness and lateral response and align gauge and bedding directions; compare isotropic and anisotropic inversion residuals, reporting model bounds when data cannot identify every elastic constant. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using stiffness from the wrong direction biases stress ratios, and adding gauges without directional diversity does not cure it. An overparameterized inversion can fit noise perfectly while losing physical credibility.
units.failure: 模數選錯方向會使應力比例偏差，增加量規數卻不增加方向資訊仍不能解決；過度參數化反演可能完美擬合雜訊而失去物理可信度。~Using stiffness from the wrong direction biases stress ratios, and adding gauges without directional diversity does not cure it. An overparameterized inversion can fit noise perfectly while losing physical credibility.
units.misconception: 層理岩的不同方向模數可以任意交換而不影響反演。~Directional moduli in bedded rock can be interchanged without affecting inversion.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄彈性各向異性的資料來源與適用條件。以定向試件量測多方向剛度及泊松效應，核對儀器方向與層理方向；比較等向與各向異性反演殘差，若資料不足以辨識全部常數，需給出模型範圍而非硬湊唯一解。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for elastic anisotropy. Test oriented specimens for directional stiffness and lateral response and align gauge and bedding directions; compare isotropic and anisotropic inversion residuals, reporting model bounds when data cannot identify every elastic constant.

units.anchor: 開挖擾動與距離~Excavation disturbance and distance
units.title: 開挖擾動與距離~Excavation disturbance and distance
units.mechanism: 隧道附近量到的應力已受自由面卸載與集中影響，距掌子面遠不一定等於未擾動。應以開挖幾何、破裂帶與量測時序判斷代表性，不能直接把近壁測點當成遠場應力。 假設圓孔彈性影響項比例a²/r²，a=5 m、r=15 m時為1/9=0.111；只是幾何衰減項，不是完整應力。 將卸載後低應力當成原始狀態會低估深部風險，將局部集中當遠場又會過度放大；兩者皆使後續開挖分析的邊界載入不正確。~Stress near a tunnel is redistributed by unloading and concentration; distance from the face alone does not prove undisturbed conditions. Excavation geometry, damage and timing determine whether a measurement represents the far field. For an assumed circular-opening elastic term a²/r² with a=5 m and r=15 m, the term is 1/9=0.111; it is not the complete stress solution. Using unloaded stress as the initial state underestimates deeper risk, while treating local concentration as far-field stress exaggerates it. Both apply incorrect boundary loading in subsequent excavation analysis.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設圓孔彈性影響項比例a²/r²，a=5 m、r=15 m時為1/9=0.111；只是幾何衰減項，不是完整應力。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed circular-opening elastic term a²/r² with a=5 m and r=15 m, the term is 1/9=0.111; it is not the complete stress solution.
units.verify: 把測點放入已記錄施工階段的三維模型，與不同距離、不同時間測點比較；若近壁裂隙或塑性明顯，需使用相應模型說明擾動，不能用單一距離門檻宣布原位代表性。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：將卸載後低應力當成原始狀態會低估深部風險，將局部集中當遠場又會過度放大；兩者皆使後續開挖分析的邊界載入不正確。~Place measurements in a model matching recorded excavation stages and compare locations and times; where near-wall cracking or plasticity is evident, model disturbance explicitly rather than declaring representativeness from one distance threshold. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using unloaded stress as the initial state underestimates deeper risk, while treating local concentration as far-field stress exaggerates it. Both apply incorrect boundary loading in subsequent excavation analysis.
units.failure: 將卸載後低應力當成原始狀態會低估深部風險，將局部集中當遠場又會過度放大；兩者皆使後續開挖分析的邊界載入不正確。~Using unloaded stress as the initial state underestimates deeper risk, while treating local concentration as far-field stress exaggerates it. Both apply incorrect boundary loading in subsequent excavation analysis.
units.misconception: 洞壁附近的應力量測必定就是未擾動遠場應力。~A measurement near the tunnel wall necessarily represents undisturbed far-field stress.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄開挖擾動與距離的資料來源與適用條件。把測點放入已記錄施工階段的三維模型，與不同距離、不同時間測點比較；若近壁裂隙或塑性明顯，需使用相應模型說明擾動，不能用單一距離門檻宣布原位代表性。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for excavation disturbance and distance. Place measurements in a model matching recorded excavation stages and compare locations and times; where near-wall cracking or plasticity is evident, model disturbance explicitly rather than declaring representativeness from one distance threshold.

units.anchor: 反演殘差與不確定~Inversion residuals and uncertainty
units.title: 反演殘差與不確定~Inversion residuals and uncertainty
units.mechanism: 多通道反演可利用冗餘資料檢查模型，但小殘差只表示資料彼此相容，不代表假設一定正確。系統性溫度偏差會同時污染多個通道，須以獨立方法與重複測點辨識。 假設三個應變殘差3、−4、0 με，RMSE=√(25/3)=2.89 με；此值不含共同零點偏移。 只選殘差最小的模型可能選中過度擬合，測點共享校準偏差又讓重複結果看似可靠；其後把窄信賴區間當成真實地質均一性會誤導設計。~Redundant channels test internal model consistency, but small residuals do not prove correct assumptions. A systematic thermal bias can contaminate all channels together and requires independent methods and repeated locations to identify. For assumed strain residuals 3,−4 and 0 με, RMSE=√(25/3)=2.89 με; this excludes a shared zero offset. Choosing the smallest residual can favor overfitting, and shared calibration bias makes repeated measurements appear reliable. A narrow fitted interval may then be wrongly treated as evidence of uniform geological stress.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三個應變殘差3、−4、0 με，RMSE=√(25/3)=2.89 με；此值不含共同零點偏移。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed strain residuals 3,−4 and 0 με, RMSE=√(25/3)=2.89 με; this excludes a shared zero offset.
units.verify: 檢查殘差方向與溫度、深度及量規通道的相關性，以留一通道方式檢查反演穩健性；報告保留原始訊號、校準與參數協方差，對共同偏差另做敏感度分析。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只選殘差最小的模型可能選中過度擬合，測點共享校準偏差又讓重複結果看似可靠；其後把窄信賴區間當成真實地質均一性會誤導設計。~Examine residual correlations with temperature, depth and channel and test leave-one-channel stability; retain raw signals, calibrations and parameter covariance, with separate sensitivity analysis for common-mode biases. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Choosing the smallest residual can favor overfitting, and shared calibration bias makes repeated measurements appear reliable. A narrow fitted interval may then be wrongly treated as evidence of uniform geological stress.
units.failure: 只選殘差最小的模型可能選中過度擬合，測點共享校準偏差又讓重複結果看似可靠；其後把窄信賴區間當成真實地質均一性會誤導設計。~Choosing the smallest residual can favor overfitting, and shared calibration bias makes repeated measurements appear reliable. A narrow fitted interval may then be wrongly treated as evidence of uniform geological stress.
units.misconception: 反演殘差很小就證明不存在共同感測器偏差。~Small inversion residuals prove that common sensor bias is absent.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄反演殘差與不確定的資料來源與適用條件。檢查殘差方向與溫度、深度及量規通道的相關性，以留一通道方式檢查反演穩健性；報告保留原始訊號、校準與參數協方差，對共同偏差另做敏感度分析。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for inversion residuals and uncertainty. Examine residual correlations with temperature, depth and channel and test leave-one-channel stability; retain raw signals, calibrations and parameter covariance, with separate sensitivity analysis for common-mode biases.

units.anchor: 應力模型工程移交~Engineering stress-model handover
units.title: 應力模型工程移交~Engineering stress-model handover
units.mechanism: 場址應力模型需整合多種方法、地形與構造，保留互相矛盾的資料及解釋。模型應提供應力張量隨位置的範圍，而非只有三個代表值；施工揭露新資訊時才能合理更新邊界條件。 假設三測點最大主應力18、22、26 MPa，平均22 MPa、範圍8 MPa；小樣本不能據此宣稱全場正態分布。 把不同深度和不同方法直接平均會抹去構造分區，缺少符號或坐標定義更會使接收者誤用；即使平均數正確，整個開挖模型仍可能承受錯向載入。~A site stress model integrates methods, topography and structure while retaining contradictory data and interpretations. Spatial tensor ranges, rather than only three representative numbers, allow excavation evidence to update boundary conditions rationally. Assumed maximum principal stresses 18,22 and 26 MPa have mean 22 MPa and range 8 MPa; this small sample does not establish a site-wide normal distribution. Averaging different depths and methods erases structural domains; missing signs or coordinate definitions invite misuse. Even a correct average can apply loads in the wrong direction to the excavation model.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三測點最大主應力18、22、26 MPa，平均22 MPa、範圍8 MPa；小樣本不能據此宣稱全場正態分布。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed maximum principal stresses 18,22 and 26 MPa have mean 22 MPa and range 8 MPa; this small sample does not establish a site-wide normal distribution.
units.verify: 交付各測點坐標、方法、時間、排水狀態與張量不確定度，選取低中高情境重算主控機制；由岩工、設計與施工負責人確認哪些新觀測會觸發模型重審。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把不同深度和不同方法直接平均會抹去構造分區，缺少符號或坐標定義更會使接收者誤用；即使平均數正確，整個開挖模型仍可能承受錯向載入。~Deliver coordinates, methods, time, drainage and tensor uncertainty for each location and analyze low, central and high scenarios; rock, design and construction leads agree which new observations trigger model review. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Averaging different depths and methods erases structural domains; missing signs or coordinate definitions invite misuse. Even a correct average can apply loads in the wrong direction to the excavation model.
units.failure: 把不同深度和不同方法直接平均會抹去構造分區，缺少符號或坐標定義更會使接收者誤用；即使平均數正確，整個開挖模型仍可能承受錯向載入。~Averaging different depths and methods erases structural domains; missing signs or coordinate definitions invite misuse. Even a correct average can apply loads in the wrong direction to the excavation model.
units.misconception: 不同深度的應力只要取平均就可代表整個場址。~Averaging stress measurements at different depths adequately represents the entire site.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄應力模型工程移交的資料來源與適用條件。交付各測點坐標、方法、時間、排水狀態與張量不確定度，選取低中高情境重算主控機制；由岩工、設計與施工負責人確認哪些新觀測會觸發模型重審。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for engineering stress-model handover. Deliver coordinates, methods, time, drainage and tensor uncertainty for each location and analyze low, central and high scenarios; rock, design and construction leads agree which new observations trigger model review.

example: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平均密度2600 kg/m³、深度500 m，σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa；未計地形與構造修正。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平面σx=12、σy=8、τxy=3 MPa，主值10±√13，得13.61及6.39 MPa；未代表第三主值。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。~Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed mean density 2600 kg/m³ and depth 500 m, σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa, excluding topographic and tectonic corrections. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed plane components σx=12, σy=8 and τxy=3 MPa, principal values are 10±√13=13.61 and 6.39 MPa; no third principal stress is specified. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
history: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示區分原位應力、測試擾動與反演假設，建立可審查的應力模型需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。~FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why separate in-situ stress, test disturbance and inversion assumptions in an auditable stress model requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設平均密度2600 kg/m³、深度500 m，σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa；未計地形與構造修正。~Teaching quantitative note: With assumed mean density 2600 kg/m³ and depth 500 m, σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa, excluding topographic and tectonic corrections.

教學量化備忘：假設平面σx=12、σy=8、τxy=3 MPa，主值10±√13，得13.61及6.39 MPa；未代表第三主值。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed plane components σx=12, σy=8 and τxy=3 MPa, principal values are 10±√13=13.61 and 6.39 MPa; no third principal stress is specified.
教學量化備忘：假設σ=15 MPa、u=3 MPa、α=0.8，σ′=σ−αu=12.6 MPa；若係數α=1則為12 MPa。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed σ=15 MPa, u=3 MPa and α=0.8, σ′=σ−αu=12.6 MPa; with α=1 it becomes 12 MPa.

教學量化備忘：假設單軸示意E=40 GPa、回復應變200 με，σ=Eε=8 MPa；實際多軸套鑽需完整校正矩陣。~Teaching quantitative note: For an assumed uniaxial illustration E=40 GPa and relieved strain 200 με, σ=Eε=8 MPa; real multiaxial overcoring requires a full calibration matrix.

教學量化備忘：假設地表讀值8 MPa、測段低100 m且水密度1000 kg/m³，靜水修正0.981 MPa，井下8.981 MPa；未計流動損失。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume surface pressure 8 MPa and an interval 100 m lower with water density 1000 kg/m³; static correction 0.981 MPa gives 8.981 MPa downhole, excluding flowing losses.

教學量化備忘：假設線彈性均質等向岩、無內壓自由圓孔壁，孔軸沿第三主應力方向；遠場主水平應力20與10 MPa，最大環向壓應力3×20−10=50 MPa。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume homogeneous isotropic linear elasticity, a traction-free circular wall without internal pressure, and borehole axis along the third principal direction; horizontal principal stresses 20 and 10 MPa give maximum hoop compression 50 MPa.
